author: Mark Atwood
text: Slice-A inventory result (closed via comment): (a) python/schc/headers.py:295 has explicit ULA fd00::/8 predicate — delete and simplify is_mesh_local; (b) python/coap/node_channel.py docstrings at lines 8-9 & 46-47 legalize legacy fd00 prefix — reword to 02xx-only; (c) spec/comment hygiene: rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs/hybrid.rs, python/routing/router.py contain 'ULA is external' prose — sweep wording; (d) test-vector sites: python/tests/loadng/test_{discovery,messages,error,cache}.py use fd00::1/2/3 placeholder addresses — migrate to 02xx::/8; (e) rust/lichen-ipv6/src/lib.rs and rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs 'is unique local' helpers are utilities, not callers; leave or deprecate. Acceptability of file list above establishes slice B scope.
